title: PlaybackParams
description: Effect tunables (design doc §7.8), mirroring the pulse reference's controls. All fields are optional overlays: unset fields keep the player's current/default value, so a UI can send just the slider that moved. Effects ignore params they don't use.

glowRadius.description: Soft-falloff radius around a pulse agent, meters (the pulse reference's 'soft' control).

agentCount.description: Number of concurrent pulse agents traversing the topology.

speed.description: Agent travel speed along the topology, meters per second.

palette.description: Effect color palette as 0xRRGGBB integers; empty/omitted keeps the player's default palette.

leadIn.description: Pulse lead-in/out ramp distance at termini, meters (0/omitted derives from the glow radius).

splitProb.description: Probability in [0,1] that a pulse splits into two at a junction.

decay.description: Flood fade length behind the wavefront, meters (0/omitted derives from the glow radius).
